note: ORPHAN Pro 22:6 — train up a child in the way he should go; even when old he will not depart from it.

dims.v: the durability of early training — the trained way not departed from in age

the not-departing, even in old age, from the way in which a child was trained — the enduring formation of early character, the ingrained path that holds fast through a lifetime because it was set in youth
(the way he was trained in, which he keeps)
the lasting hold of a way instilled early, kept even to old age

sur (turn aside/depart), negated — 'even when he is old he will not DEPART from it' (22:6); character formed early endures. What is trained into a child in the way he should go holds fast through life. Early formation shapes the whole course.
